info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Protected Groups API

params.name: group_id
params.description: Group ID to look up protected state for

params.name: name
params.description: Search term for filtering protected groups by group name, DBA name, or group ID

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Organization ID to filter protected groups by

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page

items.docs: Returns active protected groups. Supplying group_id performs a scoped single-group lookup for any authorized UI user. Omitting group_id lists all active protected groups and is only available to internal Noyo users.
